Finnish uses ” on both sides; TOML and command examples keep their own quotes.
Keep at the end of commands that open a dialog.

Commands use the singular imperative (Avaa, Tallenna); messages prefer the passive or impersonal forms; address the user with "sinä" (Haluatko…?) as Microsoft and Apple Finnish UIs do, never with "Te".
Only the first word of a button, menu item or title is capitalised.
Always lowercase, also at the start of a sentence. Inflect with a colon (eov:n, eov:lle); prefer nominative and genitive.
A file or plugin name cannot take case endings: write "tiedosto {}", "laajennuksen {} …" or "Avattu: {}".
Undo labels are command names in the imperative (Lisää mittaus, Aseta tarkastelualue), shown after the colon.
The Finnish alphabet ends with Ö.
